So far, the difference has been night and day. I've had a lot of bad experiences with GP surgeries where it's impossible to get face-to-face appointments and be taken seriously as a patient. But at The Range, you don't have to wait long on the phone, the admin team are friendly and helpful, and the care has been exceptionally efficient so far.
